paragraphs: A detail-oriented analyst with four years delivering over ten scalable application development and enhancement projects — across both on-premise and cloud-based deployments, and across Waterfall and Hybrid SDLC methodologies.

My technical toolkit covers Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, Azure Database, and MongoDB. My strength lies in understanding client needs, driving technical resolutions, and bridging communication between technical teams and stakeholders to reach optimal results.
